entries.title: Own key binding next to Cylex MDT and phone numbers for offline citizens

changes.text: Running the EMS MDT together with Cylex MDT (police) no longer breaks the open key: each tablet now has its own entry in Settings → Key Bindings → FiveM, so doctors pressing the key open the EMS MDT instead of getting "no permission" from the police tablet
cylex_phone: citizens who are offline now show their phone number too, and the MDT no longer waits forever when cylex_phone is slow to start or missing
New Config.OpenKeyCommand and Config.OpenKeyLabel set the name and label of the open key in the FiveM key bindings menu
When both MDTs use the same key, pressing it on the wrong job now does nothing instead of showing "no permission"
The uniform popup cursor key has its own binding and only reacts while the EMS uniform popup is open
The key bindings were renamed, so players who had changed the open or popup cursor key need to set it again once
Default language in config.lua is now English (Config.Locale = 'en')
